create.name: Michelle Chalfant
create.bio:
Michelle Chalfant is a therapist, holistic life coach, author and podcast host who created The Adult Chair, a model for understanding the parts of ourselves that drive our reactions. She grew up in a loving family that also lived with addiction and blurred boundaries, and as a young woman she struggled inwardly while seeming fine to others. That search took her through a master's degree in counselling and into private practice, and then on to training in yoga, meditation and intuition as well as energy medicine, meridian work, chakra work, EFT, NLP and PSYCH-K.

The Adult Chair joins psychology with spirituality. It pictures three inner seats, the Child, the Adolescent and the Adult, and teaches people to notice which one is in charge, to tend old wounds and to act from the steady Adult self, with practices for self-compassion, feeling emotions, handling triggers and setting boundaries. She sets this out in her book The Adult Chair, in a long-running weekly podcast and in hundreds of free guided meditations on YouTube on grounding, letting go, self-worth and opening the heart. She also runs an online community and courses, live group gatherings and a certification for coaches in her model, and she speaks to organisations about conscious leadership.

books.title: The Adult Chair: Get Unstuck, Claim Your Power, and Transform Your Life
books.author: Michelle Chalfant
books.description: Her guide to the model behind her work. It explains how the Child, Adolescent and Adult chairs shape our reactions and relationships, then offers five daily practices, from owning one's reality and self-compassion to working with triggers and keeping firm boundaries, as a route back to the true self.
